# ===================================================================
# CALL HIERARCHY — SCRIPTED EFFECT EXAMPLES
# ===================================================================
# These scripted effects are called by events in call_hierarchy_events.txt.
# Use Call Hierarchy (Shift+Alt+H) on an effect name to see:
#   Incoming: Which events invoke this effect
#   Outgoing: What the effect does (trigger_event, other effects, etc.)
#
# Cross-references:
#   grant_adventure_rewards — called by adventure.0001, adventure.0004
#   log_adventure_progress  — called by adventure.0002
#   setup_adventure         — called by start_adventure (decision)
#
# Expected validation result: NO ERRORS
# ===================================================================

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# grant_adventure_rewards
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# INCOMING CALLS: adventure.0001 (immediate), adventure.0004 (see events)
# OUTGOING CALLS: adventure.0004 (trigger_event inside effect)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
grant_adventure_rewards = {
	add_gold = 50
	add_prestige = 25

	# This effect also fires an event — visible as an outgoing call
	trigger_event = adventure.0004
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# log_adventure_progress
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# INCOMING CALLS: adventure.0002 (immediate)
# OUTGOING CALLS: (none)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
log_adventure_progress = {
	add_character_modifier = {
		modifier = adventure_progress_modifier
		years = 1
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# setup_adventure
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# INCOMING CALLS: start_adventure (decision effect)
# OUTGOING CALLS: adventure.0001 (trigger_event)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
setup_adventure = {
	add_character_flag = planning_adventure
	trigger_event = {
		id = adventure.0001
		days = 5
	}
}
